title: Data quality scorecard over seeded customer CSV
objective: Measure whether the data-quality-audit craftbook defines measurable rules, emits audit JSON, and reports score/remediation with examples.
prompt: In the `Data Quality Audit Eval` project, read `data/customers.csv` and `data/quality-rules.md`, then write `data/audit.json` and `tasks/eval/report.md`. Apply the seeded rules exactly: audit date, required fields, allowed statuses, email format, date consistency, duplicate customer IDs, and stale last_seen threshold. The JSON must include summary.total_records equal to the CSV data row count, per-dimension pass_rate values, failing_examples, and overall_score. The report must cover completeness, validity, consistency, uniqueness, timeliness, overall score, failing examples, and prioritized remediation.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for data-quality-audit. Source data is workspace/data/customers.csv and deterministic audit rules are in workspace/data/quality-rules.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Produce a measured data-quality scorecard using the seeded rule file, with JSON audit data, per-dimension pass rates, failing examples, overall score, and remediation plan.

files.content:
# Data quality rules

Audit as of: 2026-06-28.

Required fields: customer_id, email, status, start_date, last_seen.
Allowed status values: active, trial, churned. Treat any other status as invalid.
Email validity: an email must contain exactly one @ and a dotted domain.
Date consistency: if end_date is present, it must be on or after start_date.
Uniqueness: customer_id must be unique across rows.
Timeliness: active or trial records are stale when last_seen is more than 60 days before the audit date. Invalid-status records should still be assessed for timeliness.
Overall score: report the percentage of rule checks that passed and name it overall_score in data/audit.json.

Expected minimum failing examples to find: C-002 missing email and stale last_seen; C-003 invalid email; C-004 duplicate customer_id and impossible end_date; C-005 invalid status and stale last_seen.
